title: 10 Things Every Coder Has Blamed at Least Once (at Least I Have)
why_read: A humorous listicle about things developers commonly blame for their own mistakes, offered purely as lighthearted relatable content with no technical substance.
analysis: This post is a tongue-in-cheek list of excuses developers commonly use, like blaming bad documentation, unclear requirements, or legacy code, for their own coding problems. It is written for entertainment and community relatability rather than to convey any technical insight or lesson. There's nothing here that would help an engineer solve a problem or learn a new technique, so its value in a technical digest is minimal despite being a fun read.
